lighting_shading.note: Soft top-left light creates gentle volume and a soft contact shadow.

value_contrast.note: Black patches provide strong contrast against the white ball and green field.

color_palette.note: Classic black and white subject stands out against the vibrant green background.

composition_hierarchy.note: The ball is the sole, dominant focal point, centered and large.

shape_proportions.note: Perfectly spherical and simplified, with a highly readable, iconic silhouette.

viewpoint_depth.note: Slightly elevated view shows the ball's volume and its place on the field.

edges_linework.note: Clean, soft edges defined by shading rather than hard lines.

surface_finish.note: Smooth, slightly glossy finish typical of stylized 3D game assets.

pose_rhythm.note: Static, balanced composition with the repeating pattern of the ball's panels.
